title: Dobogai
creator: CrossFit
description: Seven rounds of 8 muscle-ups and a 22-yard farmers carry with 50/35 lb dumbbells. Honours U.S. Army Capt. Derek A. Dobogai, killed in a helicopter crash in Multaka, Iraq, in 2007. 56 muscle-ups; scale to 8 pull-ups plus 8 dips, or 4 muscle-ups a round.
